title: Distinguish Chrome tabs: dynamic document.title with workspace label (+ optional state prefix/favicon)
outcome:
Chrome tab title is the static <title>TermAl</title> from index.html, so multiple TermAl tabs are indistinguishable (narrow tabs truncate to ~5 chars).

Proposal:
1. Dynamic document.title = "{workspace label} - TermAl" (distinctive part FIRST because Chrome truncates from the right).
2. Workspace label cascade: (a) new editable `name` field on the workspace layout (persists via existing /api/workspaces PUT; edit control in the workspace switcher), (b) fallback: dominant project among session tabs, (c) fallback: active session name.
3. Optional attention prefix: a marker when any session is asking for approval, unread count — lets the user pick the right tab without clicking.
4. Optional per-workspace favicon (colored dot derived from workspace id via canvas data URI) — distinguishes tabs even at zero text width.

Implementation: small App-level effect updating document.title on workspace/session state changes; favicon swap optional second step. Requested by Greg 2026-08-21 (screenshot: five identical "TermA..." tabs).
disposal_reason: Backlog triage w-930e4d333f07 (Architect1 batch 2, spot-checked by Termal::Fable2): CLOSE-DONE. Dynamic title shipped (ui/src/App.workspace-layout.test.tsx:1004); the favicon part was optional.
